entries.note: The platform's row for a processing centre on the land route, the city's name standing as the ellipsis: Guangzhou, Khorgos on the Kazakh border, then Moscow. The row's place names the city.
The parcel leaves a processing centre on the land route, the city's name standing as the ellipsis.
The Russian courier, which the record does not name, takes the parcel in Moscow, its sending city, after the land route; the parcel is already on its way, so this is transit, not acceptance.
The Russian courier sends the parcel on from Moscow.
The parcel reaches a transit city of the Russian courier.

entries.wording: Принят в городе получателя. Готов к выдаче
entries.english: Accepted in the recipient's city. Ready for collection
entries.note: The parcel waits for the recipient at the courier's point in the recipient's city.
